description: This file defines the EmailReminder class responsible for sending email reminders for scheduled meetings and calls, retrieving pending reminders, and managing recipients. It also includes logic for constructing email content and interacting with various modules and database entities in the SuiteCRM system.

classes.name: EmailReminder
classes.description: A class for managing email reminders for meetings and calls, including retrieving pending reminders, composing emails, and sending them to relevant recipients.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the EmailReminder object, setting the current time and maximum time window for reminders based on global settings.

methods.name: process
methods.description: Main method that retrieves pending reminders for meetings and calls, and sends email reminders accordingly.

methods.name: sendReminders
methods.description: Handles email composition and dispatch for a specific activity (meeting or call), to its recipients.

methods.name: setReminderBody
methods.description: Populates the email template with activity details and user information.

methods.name: getMeetingsForRemind
methods.description: Fetches IDs of meetings scheduled within the reminder window that are pending reminders.

methods.name: getCallsForRemind
methods.description: Fetches IDs of calls scheduled within the reminder window that are pending reminders.

methods.name: getRecipients
methods.description: Retrieves email addresses and contact info of users, contacts, and leads associated with a specific activity.
